Done: `_contentElements` is now delegated to the heading (`delegateProps`) and the button binds `.ariaControlsElements` in `render()`; `__updateAriaControls()` and its `updateComplete` wait are removed. Added the two tests for a replaced heading and replaced content. The accordion test group passes (78 tests) and eslint/prettier are clean.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
